leftEvidence.title: The hearers received law ordained by angels but did not keep it

points.label: Angelic mediation
points.left: Angels locate how the law was received.
points.right: Angels and a mediator locate the law within an argument about promise.

points.label: Rhetorical use
points.left: The claim intensifies an accusation of resistance and disobedience.
points.right: The claim distinguishes the law’s later arrival and temporary function.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving their participants, setting, sequence, genre, and inference boundaries.

rightEvidence.title: The law was ordained through angels by a mediator after the promise

payload.tension: The shared mediation claim serves different speakers, disputes, and arguments.
payload.title: The law described as mediated through angels
